card.name: Start of salt names in drug names
card.fires_on: The first piece of a salt word that follows a drug name, such as Ph in phosphate, ART in aspartate, F in sulfate or cit in citrate. It fires in drug labels, mainly on capitalised drug names.

modes.label: Phosphate after drug name
modes.description: The Ph that starts phosphate right after a drug name like clindamycin or codeine.

modes.label: Other salts
modes.description: The opening piece of aspartate, sulfate or citrate after the base drug name.

card.writes: It suggests the next piece that finishes a salt word, though the listed tokens are mostly unrelated.
card.plain: It fires when a drug name is followed by the start of its salt, like phosphate or citrate.
